tests.finding: Left-padding preserves prompt end token ':' at index -1 across variable sequence lengths. Right-padding places pad_token_id at index -1 for shorter sequences, proving default logits[:, -1, :] on right-padded batches targets padding.

After '\nAnswer:', prompt continuation with space (' A', ' B', ' C', ' D') produces single tokens (IDs 362, 425, 356, 422). Prompt continuation without space merges with colon (':A' -> 55648). Extracting unnormalized logit of token 264 (' a') introduces massive English unigram prior bias.

Absolute index injection (delta[:, 14, :] = inj) under left-padded batches creates an embedding discrepancy of 1.171292 between batch_size=1 and batch_size=2 for the exact same prompt, because index 14 lands in a zero-masked padding token in longer batches.

MCQA prompt template has year digit 3 at token 14. Rel prompt template has entity name (' Norway') at token 14 and year at tokens 4..7, proving 100% of Rel questions had seam injection applied to entity rather than year.
All 852 Rel cases in eval_5292 match regex comparison pattern. Unconditional target flip (Yes<->No) assumes strict inequality V(Y1) != V(Y2); equality ties produce invalid flipped gold.
